Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly extract data from the IMDb filmography page. Specifically, in step 10, the WebSurfer concluded that "The Story of Adele H." (runtime ~1h 37m, rating ~7.4) was the highest-rated film under 2 hours. However, the actual highest-rated Isabelle Adjani film under 2 hours is "Bluebeard" (rating ~7.7). The agent's failure to identify "Bluebeard" during the scrolling and data extraction phase (which started early but culminated in the incorrect conclusion in step 10) led to the wrong answer. Additionally, the agent likely failed to verify the specific availability of "Bluebeard" on Vudu, assuming availability based on general popularity rather than checking the specific title, further contributing to the error.
